pres.title: Present tense: all four conjugations

sum.title: Present tense: sum (I am)
sum.note: sum is followed by the nominative, not the accusative.

servus.title: Second declension: servus, puer, ager, vir
servus.note: magister and liber go like ager.

bonus.title: Adjectives: bonus (good)
bonus.note: An adjective has the same gender, case and number as its noun.

miser.title: Adjectives in -er: miser and pulcher
miser.note: noster and sacer go like pulcher.

perf.title: Perfect tense
perf.note: Endings: -i, -isti, -it, -imus, -istis, -erunt. The perfect stem comes from the third principal part.

ne.title: Questions with -ne
ne.note: -ne on the first word turns a statement into a question.
